pull.title: users: add public service specializations
pull.body:
## Summary
- add Flyway V33 and a normalized `user_service_categories` relation with FK/unique/index invariants
- let authenticated users read and replace up to 10 service specializations through dedicated owner-only endpoints
- accept only active concrete leaf categories from the existing service catalog
- update selections transactionally by diff so unchanged rows are retained and unique constraints are not churned
- expose active specialization metadata on the existing public profile response
- add a grouped specialization editor to profile settings using the existing public category catalog
- render declared specializations on public marketplace profiles
- add backend regression tests and update profile/privacy documentation

## API
- `GET /users/me/service-categories`
- `PUT /users/me/service-categories` with `{ "categoryIds": [...] }`
- `GET /users/{id}/profile` now includes `serviceCategories`

## Privacy / lifecycle
- specializations contain only public catalog metadata; they do not expose exact location, routes, live tracking, wallet/payment data or verification documents
- selecting a category does not automatically accept jobs, subscribe to alerts, change availability or grant participant-only access
- specialization updates are separate from `PATCH /users/me/profile`, preventing older clients from accidentally clearing the selection
- deactivated catalog categories stop being advertised publicly

## Validation
Run Maven verify, frontend audit/lint/build, containers/runtime smoke, Reviews trust smoke and Identity verification smoke where selected by the workflow. Do not merge unless the latest head is fully green.
